pages.html:
Summary

The harness asks a short set of questions, writes two candidates, and edits them from the chat. This quarter added link capture, Office uploads, and templates extracted from a brand.

What changed

  • Link capture reads a website into the run.
  • Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files are inlined as text.
  • A template can be extracted from a website or from brand files.

What is next

Documents join demos and decks as a third kind, with PDF and DOCX exports.
